answer: New identities claim one atlas cell and post a 4 POA ferrous bond per cell; a wallet’s nth identity must claim a fresh cell and pay 4×n POA, so the 1st fake pays 4, the 10th pays 40, 220 POA across ten. A falcon auditor re-runs one random job per cell each epoch; a fake cell with no real work forfeits its bond and the cell is struck from the atlas, so clones cannot share one cell’s honest work.
